name: Media Pixabay
description: Adds a Pixabay search widget to Entity Browser: editors search Pixabay by keyword and the selected images are downloaded server-side and saved as image media entities.
project_description:
Drupal 7 version 

Media: Pixabay adds Pixabay as a separate media provider. It's not embedding anything but saves the image to your media repository.

 You can search for images from Pixabay trough the media browser and save them as an image in your repository.

This module is ideal for bloggers, agencies, and portals who need royalty-free images, and you can save time doing this trough the Drupal media browser.

 Drupal 8, 9 and 10 version 

Adds a new Pixabay widget for the Entity browser. When images are selected in the widget, they are also added to your media repository.

 You can search for images from Pixabay through the entity browser and save them

as a media type with the image source plugin in your media repository and directly to entities. This module

is ideal for bloggers, agencies, and portals who need royalty-free images through the Drupal entity browser.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Search images - photos and illustrations 
 Save image to your site with single click 
 Drupal 8 version provides a Pixabay widget for the Entity browser 
 Full API access support and image size selection in the 2.0.0 version 
 
 Planned 
 
 More granular features as filtering per category, choosing image orientations, etc.. 
 Video support 
 Direct media add through the admin toolbar 
 
 Back to top 

 What is Pixabay 
 All images and videos on Pixabay are released free of copyrights under Creative Commons CC0. You may download, modify, distribute, and use them royalty free for anything you like, even in commercial applications. Attribution is not required.

 More information on this link: https://pixabay.com/en/service/faq/ 

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 7.x branch depends on Media Internet, a module provided by the Media module.

8.x branch has dependencies on the core Media module and the Entity browser module .

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Media: Pixabay can be installed via the standard Drupal module installation process .

 Once installed, you must register for a Pixabay API key and enter it into the Media: Pixabay settings page. Further configuration information is written in the readme file of the module.

 Related Modules 
 For a full list of media providers, media players and other media extensions, see Modules that Extend the Media Module.
